title: Chapter 1405 - 17: The Yuan Emperor Tianyuan, Invincible Among Immortal Kings
content:
Chapter 1405 - 17: The Yuan Emperor Tianyuan, Invincible Among Immortal Kings

Chapter 1405: Chapter 17: The Yuan Emperor Tianyuan, Invincible Among Immortal Kings

"Hmm?"

Reincarnation Immortal King, Immortal King Bai Bin, and Wushen Immortal King were all stunned.

Try?

Lin Yuan wants to try?

Wants to try continuing to carve out the remaining Xian road?

The Xian road leading to the core area of the illusory world, which endures overwhelming binding and compressive forces, even the Reincarnation Immortal King at the peak of Immortal King does not dare to continue opening it.

Lin Yuan’s cultivation speed was unprecedented, becoming an Immortal King in just over two million years.

But wanting to continue opening the next part of the Xian road, even with the peak strength of an Immortal King, is impossible.

Moreover, Lin Yuan had only entered the Xian road for a few hundred years and could not possibly be at the peak of Immortal King directly.

Lin Yuan glanced at the three perplexed Immortal Kings without explaining, merely stepping forward gently.

Swoosh!

Lin Yuan’s figure silently appeared at the forefront, even ahead of the Reincarnation Immortal King, who had been leading the way.

In an instant, a pressure that could obliterate everything enveloped them.

Previously, with the Reincarnation Immortal King blocking most of the pressure, even ordinary Red Dust Immortals could withstand it.

Now, as Lin Yuan stood at the forefront opening the way, he naturally had to bear most of the pressure originating from the illusory world.

Buzz buzz buzz~ With a slight movement of thought, Lin Yuan’s internal universe swept out in an instant, resisting all binding and compressive forces.

Now, Lin Yuan’s internal universe, in every aspect, surpassed the Chaos Void, this kind of top-tier dimensional space. Once he used this as a foundation to activate the Divine Ability ’World’, the external universe he formed had such strong defense that even a Time Lord couldn’t easily shake it.

Under normal circumstances, unless a Time Lord paid a huge price, they couldn’t deal with top-tier dimensional spaces like the Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan’s internal universe surpasses the Chaos Void, naturally making the Time Lord even more helpless.

The essence of the illusory world at the end of the Xian road is extremely high, yet Lin Yuan does not need to face its full power, only an insignificant part, which his external universe can easily handle.

"Go."

Lin Yuan strode towards the illusory world.

Just relying on his internal universe, Lin Yuan could overpower and crush a number of Immortal Kings, which are Second Realm time beings.

Compared to before descending into the third source world, where Lin Yuan had to ponder deeply just to suppress a single Gray Ancestor, now his strength had increased so much, with a fully converted immortal material body and insights gained from the illusory world over the past few hundred years.

If the Gray Ancestor appeared before Lin Yuan again, it would be suppressed in a breath.

Rumble~~~

The endless overwhelming binding and compressive forces were completely blocked, as Lin Yuan strode forward, soon reaching a position very close to the core area of the illusory world.

Standing here, Lin Yuan could clearly observe the surface of the illusory world, covered in chains of terrifying aura.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan turned back, noticing the three Immortal Kings staring blankly in place.

"This....."

Reincarnation Immortal King, Immortal King Bai Bin, and Wushen Immortal King were still pondering the meaning of ’let me try,’ only to find Lin Yuan had already traversed the remaining Xian road, leaving them a bit bewildered.

What had they seen?

How is this possible?!

...

"Emperor Tianyuan, he?"

The dozens of Red Dust Immortals following behind the Immortal Kings also stared in disbelief at what lay before them.

"The closer it is to the illusory world, the more terrifying the compressive force becomes. The Reincarnation Immortal King stopped because he wasn’t sure he could withstand the compressive force ahead, yet Emperor Tianyuan easily traversed the most difficult latter half of the Xian road?"

"It’s too terrifying. How exactly did Emperor Tianyuan do it? I don’t even feel like he struggled."

"If the compressive forces in the latter half of the Xian road remain unchanged, then Emperor Tianyuan’s strength definitely surpasses the Reincarnation Immortal King."

The gaze of each Red Dust Immortal was filled with wonder. They had already been comprehending the Xian road for endless ages, and the more they did so, the more terrifying they felt the illusory world was. Emperor Tianyuan so effortlessly opened a difficult path to the core area’s Xian road.

...

Reincarnation Immortal King, Immortal King Bai Bin, and Wushen Immortal King were still dazed.

"Reincarnation, aren’t you coming up?" Lin Yuan immediately transmitted a message.

In order to open a stable Xian road and resist the compressive forces originating from the illusory world, merely the beginning was needed. Thereupon, space and time still needed to be stabilized to create a firm environment.

Otherwise, Lin Yuan would have to constantly resist the compressive forces of the illusory world, and even if he could still spare the effort to comprehend, the efficiency would certainly be greatly reduced.

"Yes, yes, yes."

"Tianyuan, we will follow at once."

The Reincarnation Immortal King immediately reacted. Although Lin Yuan opening the Xian road alone somewhat broke their understanding, it was obviously a good thing.

Being able to comprehend in such a position close to the core area of the illusory world, the efficiency would definitely be much higher than other Xian roads.

"Everyone, start stabilizing the Xian road immediately."

The Reincarnation Immortal King immediately looked at the many Red Dust Immortals. Now that the most difficult part of opening the Xian road had been achieved by Lin Yuan, stabilizing the Xian road was left to them.

With the Reincarnation Immortal King’s command, the many Red Dust Immortals were instantly full of vigor.

Originally, they thought they had to abandon this Xian road and choose another to open, but unexpectedly Emperor Tianyuan forcibly opened the remaining Xian road.

Now these Red Dust Immortals were merely following in the wake of Emperor Tianyuan.

...

"The Xian road that Reincarnation opened..."

The Immortal Kings of the other four Xian roads also looked over immediately, their expressions filled with disbelief.

"The Xian road leading to the core area of the illusory world, opened so effortlessly?"

"Mainly because Emperor Tianyuan opened it, Reincarnation merely managed to open the easiest first half."
